call_points.text: FY27 revenue growth target deferred to end-September; management says it will grow but won't quantify.
Aim is to sustain ~15% operating EBITDA margin, not expand it, despite price hikes.
Tower crane capacity already raised to about 1,000 cranes via a rented nearby premises; expansion decision deferred to September.
Defence expected at 5-6% and exports 6-7% of FY27 revenue, together 10-12%.
Anti-dumping duty on imported cranes was recommended by DGTR but not implemented by the Finance Ministry; no leads since.
Deficient monsoon can swing business 5-10%, visible in Q3 of the same year.
FY27 annual guidance deferred to mid-Q2FY27; management cites crude, rupee and steel inflation.
Anti-dumping duty on Chinese cranes recommended by DGTR in September but not yet notified by Finance Ministry; fate uncertain.
Company remains debt-free; surplus cash of ~₹700-750 Cr invested in non-current instruments, mostly liquid.
Q4FY26 other income was negative due to mark-to-market losses; expects recovery to ₹20-35 Cr in Q1FY27.

guidance.statement: EBITDA margin (excluding other income) to be sustained in the 15-16% range.
Revenue target of ₹6,000-6,200 Cr by FY29, or latest by FY30.
Defence revenue to contribute 5-6% of FY27 revenue, or ₹200-220 Cr.
KATO JV to generate revenue of upwards of ₹300 Cr in 3-4 years.
FY27 revenue growth target to be given by end-September; company expects to grow
Operating EBITDA margin to be maintained at a little over 15%
FY27 capex of ₹200-250 Cr, including ₹130-140 Cr for land and ₹40-50 Cr for defence plant
Exports 6-7% and defence 5-6% of FY27 revenue, together 10-12%
Defence revenue of more than ₹200 Cr in FY27, 10-15% above plan

operating_notes.text: Blended capacity utilisation for cranes, metal handling and construction equipment stood at around 60% in FY26.
Tower crane volumes were close to 680-690 units in FY26, with capacity for 950-1,000 cranes.
Steel, the biggest input material, increased 20-22% since January and accounts for about 65% of cost.
Exports were close to 3% and defence around 5% of Q1FY27 revenue; Middle East (Saudi Arabia) orders pending from March could not be shipped.
Hydra pick-and-carry cranes were a little less than 60% and new-generation cranes a little more than 40% of industry volumes last year; ACE expects 60-40 this year.
Backhoe loaders averaged close to 150-160 units a quarter; data centres contribute about 1.5-2% of revenue.

timeline.summary: On May 21, 2026, ACE held its Q4FY26 earnings call, reporting flat FY26 revenue of ₹3,395 Cr and EBITDA margin of 18.33%, and deferred FY27 guidance to Q2FY27.

On its 21 July 2026 Q1FY27 call, ACE reported best-ever Q1 total income of ₹836 Cr (+19% YoY) and PAT of ₹118.59 Cr (+22.47%), deferred its FY27 revenue growth target to end-September, and said the KATO JV would become functional by end-July with meaningful revenue only from FY28.
